query: What signals are linked to longer resolution duration values?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Type of incident (connectivity, database, email) is known at open time and plausibly correlates with how long resolution takes; it lies outside the duration and carries genuine signal.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Severity/nature of issue (service_outage vs access_issue) is an ex-ante attribute that plausibly drives resolution time without restating or leaking the duration.

per_column.name: infrastructure_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope of affected infrastructure (server, network, multi_location) is knowable at intake and broader scope plausibly lengthens resolution; a legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: assigned_technician
per_column.rationale: The individual technician is a valid predictor: technician speed/skill correlates with resolution time and is not a component or restatement of duration.

per_column.name: technician_assignment_alignment
per_column.rationale: Whether the assignment matched the appropriate group/skill is an ex-ante process attribute; mis-alignment plausibly increases resolution time, a legitimate signal.

per_column.name: time_of_day_opened
per_column.rationale: Derived solely from opened_at, known at intake; off-hours openings plausibly delay resolution. Legitimate predictor and not a function of the outcome.

per_column.name: resolution_pathway_complexity
per_column.rationale: Whether the incident was escalated / multi-stage is only known during or after the resolution process itself; it is effectively part of the resolution outcome and correlates near-deterministically with duration, constituting leakage.

judge.rationale: Six of seven added columns are legitimate ex-ante predictors spanning incident type, severity, scope, technician, assignment quality, and opening time -- a diverse, non-redundant feature set that adds real leverage beyond the original columns. Only 'resolution_pathway_complexity' leaks, as escalation/multi-stage status is realized during resolution and moves with the outcome. Strong overall predictive utility, docked for the one leaking feature.
